That is name + specialty + branch + city + hospital, so not an ambiguous match. CAVEAT FOR A HUMAN: the identical page title and slug also appeared under a HITEC City path, https://www.carehospitals.com/doctor/hyderabad/hitec-city/jyothi-a-surgical-oncologist , and the Banjara Hills URL's own page title reads 'Top Surgical Oncologist in HITEC City'. Both URLs appeared verbatim in results and both serve the same biography, so I treated them as CARE's known slug/title inconsistency for one doctor rather than two people - but I recorded the second path openly rather than hiding it.
